technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and breakout confirmation, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and weak trend strength (ADX 22.54) limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: PCG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 71 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (39/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trade data (3-4 years old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 225 crisis regime, FOMC event today) creates severe headwinds; utilities defensive but credit-sensitive; earnings in 71 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: 15x volume spike with new 10/20-day highs and price above key moving averages signals institutional accumulation breakout in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 9/14, Stoch), weak ADX trend (22.54), zero fundamental conviction, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 225, FOMC today), and earnings risk in 71 days create a high-probability mean reversion trap.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical breakout with 15x volume spike and new highs offers contrarian appeal in fear zone, but macro crisis regime and overbought oscillators create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX 225 crisis regime, and FOMC event today create macro headwinds that will likely trigger mean reversion in overbought utilities; earnings in 71 days add execution uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 53 utility positions with existing PCG exposure; sector concentration + macro stress + earnings proximity warrant avoidance to preserve capital in crisis environment.
